==Description==
'''Kudos''' is an emote that could have been obtained from Sergeant III of the [[PVP Season 0]]. It was made by Capra. The emote is looped and the player cannot move while performing this emote. It is not interactable and no music can be heard from it. Sounds can be heard from the emote.

When used, the player will begin to hold a giant sign with a green thumbs up on it.
